dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I happen to agree with you.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Back then, Lynette didn't blame us for not taking care of the tableware better. She even apologized, saying that this sort of thing always happens to her...

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Maybe she only said that so we wouldn't feel too awkward about things. I mean, she seems rather cold, but she's actually super modest and polite!
